title: Quasi-coherent modules on an algebraic stack form an abelian category
statement: Work in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $\mathcal X$ an algebraic stack over $S$ [def-sfb-algebraic-moduli-stack]. Let $\operatorname{QCoh}(\mathcal X)$ be the full subcategory of sheaves of $\mathcal O_{\mathcal X}$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] on its big fppf site whose objects locally admit presentations by small direct sums of the structure module, as in [def-sfb-stack-quasi-coherent-algebra]. Then $\operatorname{QCoh}(\mathcal X)$ is an abelian category [def-sp-abelian]. No finiteness or Noetherian hypothesis is imposed.

proof.text: Choose a smooth surjective scheme atlas $a:U\to\mathcal X$ using [def-sfb-algebraic-moduli-stack]. By [lem-sfb-stack-chartwise-smooth-etale-calculus], $a$ is flat and locally of finite presentation. Clause (2) of [lem-sfb-fppf-groupoid-stack-presentations] supplies the self-relation groupoid $R=U\times_{\mathcal X}U$, with flat projections $s=p_1,t=p_2$. The relation is an algebraic space, with no assertion that it is a scheme.

By [lem-sfb-smooth-atlas-module-descent], restriction is an equivalence $E$ from $\operatorname{QCoh}(\mathcal X)$ to pairs $(M,\delta:p_1^*M\simeq p_2^*M)$ with $\delta_{13}=\delta_{23}\delta_{12}$. Replace $\delta$ by $\alpha=\delta^{-1}$: its equation becomes $\alpha_{13}=\alpha_{12}\alpha_{23}$, and $\delta_Np_1^*v=p_2^*v\delta_M$ becomes $p_1^*v\alpha_M=\alpha_Np_2^*v$. Thus this is the groupoid-module category of [lem-sfb-flat-space-groupoid-abelian], which is abelian since both projections are flat by step 1. This applies to arbitrary modules and algebraic-space relations.

source.place: Tag 06WV, lemma-quasi-coherent-algebraic-stack, proof of (2) via Tag 06WT, proposition-quasi-coherent, and Tag 06VZ, lemma-abelian.

proof.text: The full category $\operatorname{QCoh}(\mathcal X)$ is preadditive [def-weil-preadditive-category]: addition of module maps is sectionwise, stays a module map, and composition distributes sectionwise. It has finite products: for a quasi-inverse $H$ of $E$ and a finite family $(F_j)$, take $P=H(\prod_j E(F_j))$. The product exists in the abelian category of step 2 [def-sp-abelian]. Full faithfulness and the two inverse isomorphisms give $\operatorname{Hom}(F,P)\cong\operatorname{Hom}(E(F),\prod_j E(F_j))\cong\prod_j\operatorname{Hom}(F,F_j)$ naturally in $F$, with the corresponding projections. The same formula for the empty family supplies a terminal object.

source.place: Tag 06WV, lemma-quasi-coherent-algebraic-stack, categorical inference in proof of (2), with finite products transported by their defining universal property.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-preadditive-abelian-equivalence] to the preadditive category with finite products from step 3 and the equivalence to the abelian category in step 2. This proves the asserted abelianity. No finiteness or Noetherian condition has entered.
